[Verse 1]
A coin between the sidewalk and the gutter
A doorway that forgets the winter draft
I fold the evening like a borrowed letter
And place it where the hallway holds its laugh

[Verse 2]
The elevator hums a private octave
Old photographs unpeel against the stair
A stranger keeps the landing light on evenings
And counts the passing footsteps unaware

[Bridge]
Took the long way home through fading avenue
Took the long way home the radio full of static
Took the long way home and left the door ajar
